chapter.verse: “Tua hun ciangin vantung kumpigam pen a meivakte uh tawi-in zipi tangvalpa dawn dinga a pai nungak sawmte tawh kibang ding hi.
Amau teng lakah nga hai-in nga pil hi.
A hang pen tua a haite in meivak a tawi uh hangin meitui kenbeh lo uh a,
a pilte in ahihleh thawl tawh meitui kenbeh uh hi.
Zipi tangvalpa hong tung hak ahih manin nungakte lusu-in ihmukha uh hi.
Zankim laitak kikona aw khat ging a, ‘Zipi tangvalpa hong tung ta hi. Pusuakin va dawn un,’ ci hi.
Tua ciangin nungakte a vekun tho uh a, a meivak tek uh puah uh hi.
Nungak a haite in a pilte kiangah, ‘Ka meivak uh a mit ding hita hi. Meitui tawm hong hawm un,’ ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin a pilte in, ‘Ko' ading leh no' ading kicing nawnlo ahih manin meitui zuakte kiangah pai-in no' ading va leizaw un,’ ci uh hi.
Amaute meitui lei dingin a pai kalun zipi tangvalpa hong tung ta a, a kigingsa-a om teng zipi tangvalpa tawh mopawi bawlna inn sungah lut uh hi. Tua khit ciangin kongpi kikhak hi.
Tua khit nungah nungak dangte hong pai uh a, ‘Topa aw, Topa, kongpi hong hon in,’ ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin zipi tangvalpa in, ‘Maantak kong cihin ah note kong thei kei hi,’ cihsan hi.
Tua hi a, a ni a nai thei lo na hih manun pilvang navakin om un.
“Vantung kumpigam pen khualzin dinga kithawi, a silate samin a neihsa teng a kem dingin a ap, mipa tawh kibang hi.
Amau' hihzawhna tek zui-in amah in khat' kiangah talent nga, a dang khat' kiangah talent nih, leh a dang khat' kiangah talent khat, cih bangin ap hi.
Talent nga a ngahpa paikhia pahin summet bawlna-in zang a, a met talent nga ngahbeh hi.
Tua mah bangin talent nih a ngahpa in zong a met talent nih ngahbeh hi.
Ahih hangin talent khat a ngahpa ahihleh lei to-in a topa' sum selcip hi.
Sawtpi khit ciangin silate' topa hong ciah a, amaute tawh sum sianna bawl hi.
Talent nga ngahpa hong pai-in talent nga dang tawithuahin, ‘Topa aw, kei' tungah talent nga nong ap hi. En in, a met talent nga ka ngahbeh hi,’ ci hi.
A topa in, ‘Pha hi, a gina a citak silapa aw! Na a tawmno ah na citak hi. Na a tampi kong ap ding hi. Na topa tawh hong nuamsakhawm in,’ ci hi.
Tua ciangin talent nih ngahpa zong hong pai-in, ‘Topa aw, kei tungah talent nih nong ap hi. Hih takah talent nih mah ka ngahbeh hi,’ ci hi.
A topa in, ‘Pha hi, a gina a citak silapa aw, na a tawmno ah na citak hi. Na a tampi kong ap ding hi. Na topa tawh hong nuamsakhawm in,’ ci hi.
Talent khat ngahpa zong hong pai-in, ‘Topa aw, nang pen na ciin lohna mun ah an a la nuam, na vawh lohna mun ah gahleteh a khawm nuam, migenhak khat na hihlam kong thei hi.
Tua hangin ka lau a, na talent lei sungah ka seel hi. Tu-in nang' a nang'n la in,’ ci hi.
Tua ciangin a topa in, ‘Nang a gilo leh a thadah silapa aw, ka ciin lohna mun ah an la nuamin ka vawh lohna mun ah gahleteh khawm nuam ka hihlam hong thei na hi hiam?
Tua ahihleh ka sum pen summet piate' kiangah na khol ding ahi hi. Tua hileh kong ciah ciangin keima' neihsa pen a met tawh ka ngahkhawm thei ding hi.
Tua ahih manin ama' kianga talent la unla talent sawm a neipa pia un.
A hang pen a neite khempeuh kipiabeh ding a, a dimletin nei ding uh hi. A neilote ahihleh a neihsun nangawn kilaksak ding hi.
Kimanna neilo silapa a pualam khuamialna sungah kaikhia un. Tua mun ah kahna leh hagawina om ding hi,’ ci hi.
“Ama' vanmi bup tawh kithuahin Mihing' Tapa a minpha tawh hong pai ciangin ama' minphatna kumpi-tokhom tungah tu ding hi.
Ama' mai-ah minam khempeuh hong kikaikhawm ding uh a, tuucingpa in keelhon lakpan tuute a khenkhiat danin amah in mite khenkhia ding hi.
Tuute a taklam ah koih ding a, keelte ahihleh a veilam ah koih ding hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa in a taklam-a omte' kiangah, ‘No ka Pa' thupha piakte aw, leitung kilamkip hun pan note' adinga kibawlkhol kumpigam hong luah ta un.
A hang pen ka gilkial lai-in an nong pia uh hi. Ka dangtak lai-in tui nong pia uh hi. Khualmi ka hih lai-in nong dawntuah uh hi.
Guaktang-a ka om lai-in puan nong guan uh hi. Ka cinat lai-in nong khoi uh a, ka thongkiat lai-in nong hawh uh hi,’ ci ding hi.
Tua ciangin midikte in dawng ding uh a, ‘Topa aw, kote in cikin na gilkial hong mu-in an hong pia ka hi uh hiam? Cikin na dangtak hong mu-in tui hong pia ka hi uh hiam?
Cikin khualmi na hih hong mu-in hong dawntuah ka hi uh hiam? Cikin guaktang-a na om hong mu-in puan hong guan ka hi uh hiam?
Cikin na cinat na thongkiat hong mu-in hong khoi hong hawh ka hi uh hiam?’ ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa in midikte' kiangah, ‘Maantak kong cihin ah hih ka sanggamte a neupen khat tungah na bawl bangbang uh kei' tungah hong bawl na hi uh hi,’ ci ding hi.
“Tua ciangin a veilam-a omte' kiangah, ‘No samsiat ngahte aw, ka kiangpan paikhia unla dawimangpa leh a vanmite' adinga kibawlkhol tawntung meili sungah lut un.
A hang pen ka gilkial lai-in an nong pia kei uh hi. Ka dangtak lai-in tui nong pia kei uh hi.
Khualmi ka hih lai-in nong dawntuah kei uh hi. Guaktang-a ka om lai-in puan nong guan kei uh hi. Ka cinat lai leh ka thongkiat lai-in nong veh nong hawh kei uh hi,’ ci ding hi.

Tua ciangin tua mite in zong dawng ding uh a, ‘Topa aw, kote in cikin na gilkial, na dangtak, khualmi na hih, guaktang-a na om, na cinat, na thongkiat hong mu-in hong don lo ka hi uh hiam?’ ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa in tua mite' kiangah, ‘Maantak kong cihin ah hih mite a neupen khat tungah na bawl loh bangbang uh kei tungah hong bawl lo na hi uh hi,’ ci ding hi.
Tua hi a, hih mite tawntung gawtna sungah pai ding uh a, midikte ahihleh tawntung nuntakna sung lut ding uh hi.”
